thread:
maya.support: Heads-up: NimbusHealth reporting big surge of 429s after plan migration to Dedicated-XL at 2026-03-12T02:09:58Z. ~50% of requests to their reserved pool returning 429s. Ticket #5123.
maya.support: Example curl and response: 
maya.support: ```
curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-XXXX\" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{\"model\":\"rwd-large\",\"prompt\":\"ping\"}'
# HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
{\"error\":\"rate_limited\",\"message\":\"tenant rate exceeded\"}
```
ops-bot: alert: d-reserved-11 saw tenant-429s spike 02:06-02:15 UTC. link: https://dash.re/alerts/5123
mira.ops: Can someone fetch the tenant quota object and the pool assignment? Suspect migration wrote wrong quota scope.
jordan.eng: pulling tenant config: 
jordan.eng: ```
GET /internal/tenants/nimbus-health/quota
# abridged
{
  \"rate_per_min\": \"3000\",
  \"scope\": \"per_node\",
  \"assigned_pool\": \"d-reserved-11\"
}
```
jordan.eng: Whoa scope is \"per_node\" after migration. The runtime enforcement expects \"per_pool\" for dedicated contracts. That means effective capacity was divided by node count.
lee.eng: How many nodes in d-reserved-11?
priya.ops: Pool has 6 GPUs online right now. If per_node was applied, effective rate is 3000/6=500 rpm -> obvious 429s.
maya.support: Repro: ran a 60s test at 10 rps and hit 429s within 20s. Confirmed locally by simulating per_node enforcement.
lee.eng: Quick mitigation: set a per-tenant emergency_override_scope to per_pool and bump rate to safe value. Applying patch now.
controlplane-bot: PATCH /internal/tenants/nimbus-health/quota { \"scope_override\": \"per_pool\", \"rate_per_min_override\": 18000 } accepted at 02:18:11Z by lee.eng
autoscale-bot: d-reserved-11 autoscaler: scale up +3 GPUs requested based on error spike. New nodes registered 02:20:42Z.
ops-bot: Observability: 429s dropped to baseline within ~2m after override + scale. latency normalized.
mira.ops: Root cause: plan_migrate job incorrectly mapped legacy quota enum \"node\" to the runtime field expecting values [\"per_pool\",\"per_account\"], producing \"per_node\" which runtime treated as per-node division. Edge-case mismatch.
jordan.eng: Fix plan: 1) update migration to canonicalize enum values to runtime vocabulary; 2) add unit tests and a control-plane validation that rejects unknown scopes; 3) run DB audit for other tenants with non-canonical scope. I'll open a PR.
priya.ops: Ops follow-up: audit query created to find tenants with scope not in (\"per_pool\",\"per_account\"). We'll apply safe overrides for live dedicated pools and schedule a migration backfill.
lee.eng: Short-term runtime guard: if scope field not recognized and tenant assigned to dedicated pool, treat as per_pool and emit warning. This avoids new incidents while we patch.
maya.support: Notified customer at 02:32Z, they confirmed errors subsided. Closing ticket once DB audit scheduled.
controlplane-bot: Created PM ticket PM-802 for migration fix and audit. Assigned to @jordan.eng and @priya.ops. :white_check_mark:
